newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's end-Dec palm oil stocks 792,687 tonnes.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's end-Dec palm oil stocks 792,687 tonnes.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks fell 17.08 percent to 792,687 tonnes at end-December from 955,958 at end-November and compared with 859,888 at end-December 1995, the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority (PORLA) said on Wednesday.

Stocks of crude palm oil were 435,414 tonnes, against 603,888 at end-November and 496,497 a year earlier. Processed palm oil stocks totalled 357,273 tonnes compared with 352,070 and 363,391 respectively, PORLA said. Stocks of crude palm kernel oil were 59,447 tonnes at end-December against 61,511 at end-November and 55,975 at end-December 1995. Processed palm kernel oil stocks were 49,297 tonnes compared with 56,486 and 47,405 respectively.
